content.text: Waking now and then is common at 8, often tied to school stress, a busy head, or a shifting bedtime. Nightly for a stretch is worth paying attention to, though it's not unusual. Try a 10-minute "worry chat" before lights out tonight, where she gets everything off her mind. If she's up at 2am, keep it boring and calm and walk her straight back to bed with no screens or snacks. If it keeps up or she seems really distressed, mention it to your doctor.
